product_wide_rationale: Governs where every lane worker runs, how one work item reaches a second repository, and what protects a worktree from removal, across the agent surface, the workflow engine, and work coordination, so no single runtime Domain owns it.
summary: Lane workers stay native task subagents in their coordinator's directory; a work item that touches a second repository gets one coordinator session per repository, and a worktree_claim for a Project in another repository refuses with cross_repository_claim before it creates a worktree; occupancy becomes one row per session carrying the host process identity, released by session_vacate, a verified landing elsewhere, or the end of the host process, and the caller-supplied session observation is no longer a release or removal input; removal content gates stay unchanged.
title: Lane workers stay native subagents, and each repository gets its own coordinator session
